meta.association: Germline CDH23 variants have been reported as risk-associated variants in familial and sporadic pituitary adenoma cohorts, but the mechanism is not yet established to the same level as AIP, GPR101, GNAS, or USP8.

evidence.reference_title: Germline Mutations in CDH23, Encoding Cadherin-Related 23, Are Associated with Both Familial and Sporadic Pituitary Adenomas.
evidence.snippet: This mutation causes an amino acid substitution in the calcium-binding motif of the extracellular cadherin (EC) domains of CDH23 and is predicted to impair cell-cell adhesion.

nodes.description: A lactotroph (prolactin-secreting) adenoma reported in a single patient with a novel heterozygous CDH23 variant of uncertain significance. This is one case report without segregation or functional data, so it is not an established feature of the disease. In this patient the tumour was an infiltrative giant prolactinoma involving the sellar, suprasellar and parasellar regions, skull base and nasopharynx; the same paper notes that tumours in the 2017 CDH23 carriers were smaller and less invasive, so this size is a single-case observation.

evidence.reference_title: A novel germline CDH23 variant as a likely cause of an ultra-giant prolactinoma.
